## Expected and observed behavior

For vulnerabilities or exposed secrets, use the repository's Security tab and
private reporting form instead of this public issue. See SECURITY.md.

## Reproduction

Include the commit, operating system, command, and a minimal sanitized example.
Do not repeat a physical movement solely to reproduce an issue.

## Evidence and scope

Was this rehearsal, simulation, or a supervised hardware run? Include error text
without credentials, authorization headers, private photos, or raw device backups.

## Impact

Explain what is blocked and any workaround already tried.
